purpose: Controlled DT_INIT diagnostic; stop before unavailable SDK DSO registration
abi: A32 AAPCS, preserve complete guest frame; report service 0x226 and abort current invocation to saved host frame
side_effects: No guest DSO allocation, no constructors, no guest continuation; SDK init wrapper has written arguments only to its owned stack

guards.purpose: SDK DSO initialization flag starts zero
init wrapper PLT binds the intercepted DSO function
